name: turn-recovery-lost-turn-prompt
description: Soak pbd1204 (23:28-23:30): the shim froze 115 s under load, the next player's turn-start post timed out and never landed, so no turn prompt existed and the game idled 30 min. Here: pbd60 save 122; crimson's turn starts (/player turn_start, as after the previous player's pass/end turn), then its turn menu message is deleted straight through the shim (as if the post had never landed; the bot's MESSAGE_DELETE listener closes the decision). The engine's PromptRecovery must re-post crimson's turn menu (a typed turn.action decision for crimson) within ~90 s. Engine-only (no --diff: the original code never re-posts).
